reviewer_scope: CPU review of the last seven declared video jobs; no GPU, policy, source-program, raw result, frozen selection or manifest changes
judgment_scope: Selected env0 first episode of each single-geometry 32-env video run, randomized reset seed907, construction seed1, faithful reward, external heading yaw feedback and no lateral correction. Does not replace the 512-env final matrix or establish original-paper/real-robot equivalence.
measurement_limits: Continuous intervals here mean consecutive 20 ms policy-boundary samples over 1 N, not instrumented uninterrupted physics contacts.
Exposure equals sample count times 20 ms; endpoint span is reported separately.
History peaks are not contact durations.
Foot link world-XY speed under current contact is a proxy; true contact point tangential slip is not measured.
Frame/physics timing is nominal PTS +20 ms; exact synchronization was not instrumented.
Single-geometry 32-env video subsets are not the 512-env final matrix.
All retained frames are reviewed in chronological row-major contact sheets, using 320x180 thumbnails. Foot/leg occlusion and geometry overlap limit contact-point and fine-slip judgments.
No realtime playback was performed. No unverified video is silently repaired, frame-dropped or assigned a physics-time alignment.
No failure, numeric acceptance threshold, reserved final evidence or frozen checkpoint selection is revised by this descriptive review.
